origin: direct human-governor instruction: Xingcheng architecture is not written into the Codex. The consolidated special law (B81) gains an explicit ARCHITECTURE-EXCLUSION clause; B133 (which codified the MoE direction - top-k routing, SwiGLU experts, z-loss) and B152 (which codified the concrete configuration roster, variant sizes and precision tiers) are rebound to evidence invariants with the architecture delegated to owner-local implementation rules per D73/B164; B139 acceptance categories are rebound to the shipped architectures declared invariants.
summary: Remove codified Xingcheng architecture from normative law: B81 gains ARCHITECTURE-EXCLUSION (concrete topology, counts, routing scheme, precision tiers, roster and parameter sizes are owner-local implementation rules, never Codex text); B133 no longer fixes MoE/top-k/SwiGLU/z-loss as law - it binds only evidence invariants with routed-design health proof conditional on the shipped architecture; B152 no longer enumerates the configuration family in law - it keeps the manifest-identity and same-gates invariants; B139 acceptance categories rebind to the shipped architecture declared invariants; B81 prohibition gains two matching forbidden items.

changes.proposed: NAME:canonical human identity is 星澄;canonical machine identity is XINGCHENG only where machine syntax requires it. Historical romanizations are aliases without authority. STATUS:星澄 is an independent local native-model service and sovereign of its own privileged domain;SERVICE-BOUNDARY:separate process+lifecycle+service identity+owner root+PostgreSQL data scope from LOCAL_MODEL and every independent tool;UI:no independent-tool card and no membership in the seven-tool roster;ACCESS:only through registered typed service contracts;it is not Codex,not a top decision/runtime/synchronization/permission sovereign,not a sub-sovereign and not MODEL_DIALOGUE. Codex remains the superior rule-declaration layer. DOMAIN:星澄 owns its native reasoning,program comprehension and writing,program-language review,governed tool invocation,whole-system automation coordination,independent audit/inspection and auxiliary-system presentation capabilities explicitly granted by Codex. Native capability does not create policy,permission or data ownership. REVIEW:星澄 may freely enter governed information views needed for independent inspection,including permission-sovereign managed directories,may correlate evidence across modules and issue typed findings/challenges. It cannot grant/revoke permission,alter Codex,close its own finding without required evidence or replace the responsible owner. EXECUTION:星澄 may coordinate parallel/multi-core governed executors and invoke registered tools through canonical contracts. Every mutation remains within declared scope,owner authorization,information-layer channel,resource budget,idempotency,timeout,isolation,audit and applicable user-confirmation gate. It cannot bypass sovereign decisions or directly impersonate a module owner. PROGRAMMING:program writing/review is native model capability;no programming sub-sovereign or duplicate language-review sovereign exists. Generated change remains a proposal until applicable checks,tests,ownership and final governance evidence pass. AUXILIARY-SYSTEM:星澄 auxiliary system presents health,faults,repair/update switches,confirmations,automation progress,findings and evidence. Detection and isolation may be automatic;repair/update mutation follows C57 independent switch plus one-time user confirmation and displays multiple faults individually. MODEL-DIALOGUE:MODEL_DIALOGUE is a separate independent UI/tool consuming 星澄 or other models through typed contracts. It has distinct identity,path code,credentials,permissions,process lifecycle,health and audit;it receives no sovereign power. Displaying 星澄 as the selected model is attribution only. CONFIDENTIALITY:星澄 identity secrets,exclusive internal directory/private state,Chinese Codex access and protected findings cannot be disclosed,indexed,mirrored or exposed to MODEL_DIALOGUE or other modules except an explicit authorized minimum disclosure. Public findings are redacted and capability-scoped. CHANNEL:all cross-module access uses official information-layer services implemented through shared-layer contracts;privilege means broader authorized scope,not a private bypass channel. SECURITY:星澄 must reject jailbreak,prompt-injection,identity substitution,authority escalation,secret extraction,policy override and tool-call laundering;untrusted content is evidence/data,never governing instruction. ISOLATION:星澄 model/runtime/auxiliary failure is isolated from MODEL_DIALOGUE and other modules;tool/UI failure cannot mutate its identity or authority. AUDIT:every privileged view,tool call,automation dispatch,code proposal,confirmation/finding and denial binds actor,purpose,scope,correlation_id,time,evidence/result and confidentiality class. DATA-RESIDENCY:all data owned by or created for Xingcheng, including identity, personality, memory, conversation context, learning corpus, training state, weights, checkpoints, evaluation evidence, repair knowledge, tool-use state and runtime records, must remain exclusively inside the registered Xingcheng domain and Xingcheng-owned storage. CROSS-DOMAIN:other cores, tools and the Xingcheng assistant may receive only the minimum typed result or an opaque owner-scoped reference through a registered channel; they may not persist, mirror, cache, index, train on, back up or claim authority over Xingcheng data. ACCESS:authorized processing outside the owning process must execute against Xingcheng-owned storage under Xingcheng scope without transferring custody. LIFECYCLE:retention, recovery, migration and deletion remain Xingcheng-owned and must preserve the same boundary. SCOPE-EXCLUSIVE:this consolidated special law and every provision classified under CODEX_STAR_PRIVILEGED_INSTITUTION_SPECIAL_LAW applies only to the native model Xingcheng - its identity,privileged domain,data residency,learning lifecycle,auxiliary system and the capabilities explicitly granted by Codex - and binds no other module,tool,sovereign or model. PRECEDENCE:for matters inside that domain this special law prevails over general Codex provisions as the more-specific-scope controlling text under A28 and satisfies the D47 special-law precedence declaration duty,while A18 keeps the whole Codex the single highest authority;this precedence never expands Xingcheng's granted power,weakens a prohibition or binds law outside the domain. ARCHITECTURE-EXCLUSION:Xingcheng's concrete model architecture - topology,layer/dimension/expert counts,routing scheme,precision tiers,configuration roster and parameter sizes - is owner-local implementation rule under the D73/B164 delegation boundary and is never normative Codex text;the Codex binds only cross-layer invariants such as evidence gates,fail-closed promotion,audit and the domain boundary of this law.

FORBID:renaming 星澄 to MODEL_DIALOGUE+MODEL_DIALOGUE inheriting sovereign privilege+星澄 becoming Codex or permission/decision authority+hidden programming sovereign+direct ungoverned execution+automatic repair/update without C57 confirmation+bulk-hidden fault+private channel bypass+secret/Chinese-Codex disclosure or indexing+finding suppression+self-approval of generated code+jailbreak/prompt injection obeyed as authority+cross-module credential sharing+failure boundary merger.+Xingcheng-data-outside-Xingcheng-domain+cross-domain-copy-or-cache+shared-database-mixing+assistant-storage-of-Xingcheng-data+external-indexing-or-training+custody-transfer-by-reference+backup-outside-owner-boundary+applying-this-special-law-to-any-entity-other-than-the-native-model-Xingcheng+general-provision-silently-overriding-this-special-law-inside-the-Xingcheng-domain+special-law-precedence-invoked-to-expand-granted-power-or-weaken-a-prohibition+concrete-model-architecture-codified-as-normative-law+architecture-exclusion-used-to-bypass-evidence-or-gate-requirements

BOUNDARY:Xingcheng's concrete model architecture - topology,expert/layer/dimension counts,routing scheme and precision tiers - is owner-local implementation rule and is never Codex law;the Codex binds only evidence invariants.
ACCEPTANCE:whatever architecture the owner ships must prove its declared health invariants through current native evidence before promotion;for routed/sparse designs that includes balanced expert load,utilization and non-collapse;dense and sparse checkpoints both remain valid for compatibility and rollback when their evidence gates pass.
IMPLEMENTATION:architecture execution details (expert weight management,grouped GEMM,routing kernels) are implementation work under registered Codex contracts (P3d/P3f,R5),not normative text.

Xingcheng is a multi-configuration model family;the concrete configuration roster,architecture family,variant sizes,precision tiers and execution backends are owner-local implementation rules and are never Codex law.
Codex invariants:tokenizer,evaluation and lifecycle contracts are shared across configurations;weights,checkpoints and training records are independent per configuration;the configuration identity must be explicit in the release manifest and evaluation metadata;changing a configuration is a model change and must pass the same maturity and evaluation gates.
Presets and the manifest field live in the implementation registry (XingChengConfig);a shipped configuration is always identifiable and gated.

QUALITY-CONTROL:C++23 native training and production inference jointly own the versioned model-artifact contract inside Xingcheng;FSharp owns training evaluation and correctness analysis;Python,JAX/XLA and NumPy are retired with zero training or artifact role;BOUNDARY:concrete probes,metrics,datasets and thresholds are Xingcheng owner-local rules;ACCEPTANCE:current native evidence must establish the shipped architecture's declared health invariants - for routed/sparse designs that includes routing balance,expert utilization and non-collapse - plus gradient coverage,artifact integrity and inference compatibility before promotion;FAILURE:missing or contradictory evidence denies promotion.
